notes: Bonuses are derived from first-lap cumulative placing and the independent Best lap table, then checked against the published Bonif total; never from GC differences.

Seven reports have one additional timing section before the numbered laps; Brussels has nine sections and nine laps. The first-lap section is selected from these source counts before comparing bonuses.
Temps includes elapsed time to the last timing split for LAP/DNF and 0:00 for DNS; none is a finish time. finishSeconds remains null for these states.
Null Bonif cells remain null. A zero aggregate is established only from the complete three sprint awards and three best-lap awards.
The official final Ranking includes participants that never finish within five minutes. This source is preserved without treating them as regulation-eligible.
